glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.empty: No terms yet. Add names, places and words that translators should handle a particular way.
glossary.planNeeded: Editing glossaries needs a higher plan. Translators can still fill in the terms you already have.
glossary.guidelines.placeholder: How should the translation read? Tone, form of address, names, wordplay…
glossary.term.variantsHint: Plural, declensions, adjective or nicknames, separated by commas. Each can get its own translation.
glossary.term.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: a pun on “silver” and “hold”, keep both meanings if you can.
glossary.deepl.title: DeepL
glossary.deepl.intro: Send the glossary to your DeepL account, and DeepL keeps these terms in its translations, here and in its own apps. Importing a DeepL glossary brings its translations in here.
glossary.deepl.noKey: Save your DeepL API key to send this glossary to DeepL or import one from there. <link>Account keys</link>
glossary.deepl.sent: DeepL now has {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} in {languages, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}.
glossary.deepl.imported: Imported from DeepL: {updated, number} terms updated, {created, number} added, {skipped, number} skipped.
glossary.deepl.none: Your DeepL account has no glossary from the language of this work.
glossary.deepl.error.failed: DeepL could not do this right now. Try again later.
glossary.deepl.error.nothing: Translate some terms first, into a language DeepL keeps glossaries for.
glossary.deepl.error.language: Set the language of this work first.
